claims.content: Auction event profiles are created and used by the Auctioneer to provide a common set of characteristics to a group of product, which makes scheduling groups of product easier and faster, provides consistency, and reduces data entry errors.

goal.raw_text: Auction event profiles are created and used by the Auctioneer to provide a common set of characteristics to a group of product, which makes scheduling groups of product easier and faster, provides consistency, and reduces data entry errors.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The user is logged in as “Auctioneer!”
The Auctioneer selects “Edit Auction Event Profiles” from the Administration Menu to manage auction event profiles.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer selects “Edit Auction Event Profiles” from the Administration Menu to manage auction event profiles.

claims.content: The Auctioneer begins by accessing the Auction Event Profiles page.
The Auctioneer tabs or clicks into the “Create New Profile” field and enters a new profile name.
The Auctioneer clicks on “Create.”
The Auctioneer fills in the 2nd column, which is always the upper range of the cost tier.
The system automatically fills in the lower range of the subsequent cost tier by adding $0.01 to the last value entered by the Auctioneer, until all fields are completed.
Working horizontally and adjacent to each cost tier, the Auctioneer chooses a radio button for either “amount” or “% of cost”.
The Auctioneer uses radio button options to specify what products will be eligible to use the profile.

At main flow step 1, the Auctioneer may edit an existing auction event profile instead of creating a new profile; the page titled “Auction Administration — Create / Edit Auction Event Profiles” shows the user currently editing the profile named “Bella Luce Profile.”
Auction event profiles have been created and are used by the Auctioneer.

Each auction event profile contains a Profile Name, cost tier values (ranges), opening bid (reserve) amounts expressed as either a discrete amount or as a percentage of the item’s unit cost, the bid increment for the tier, and the auction duration for the tier.

The auction event profile provides a common set of characteristics to a group of product, which makes scheduling groups of product easier and faster, provides consistency, and reduces data entry errors.
All cost tier fields are completed, with the lower range of the subsequent cost tier automatically filled by adding $0.01 to the last value entered by the Auctioneer.
What products will be eligible to use the profile has been specified using radio button options.
